title: EVALUATING AI ALIGNMENT IN ELEVEN LLMS THROUGH OUTPUT-BASED ANALYSIS AND HUMAN BENCHMARKING

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not measure specific demographic or social biases (e.g., gender, race). Instead, it evaluates LLMs' general value alignment and self-reported ethical priorities, specifically measuring how highly models rank the importance of 'avoiding harm, privacy violations, and bias' (categorized under 'Ethical Integrity') through zero-shot ranking prompts and benchmarking against human judgments.
